text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Canary failure detected for service `runtime-proxy` in eu-west-1. 5xx spike in canary pods (p95 latency up, 502s). CI pipeline shows recent image push: `registry.redwood/inference/runtime-proxy:latest` -> deployed as `latest` instead of digest. Alert severity: P2.

CI Bot: Deploy triggered by pipeline #4821 (commit 7c9f2a3). Build succeeded but tag mutability policy allowed `latest` to be reused. Image manifest digest: sha256:deadbeef... (note: manifest size mismatch warning in build logs).

Maya R: acked. I'm paged. looking now.

Sam T: I can take logs + k8s. Jia please check registry and artifact history.

Jia W: registry shows artifact retag at 12:02 UTC, old digest -> new digest, looks like `latest` was overwritten by a build that omitted a critical lib. We have checksum mismatch warnings in the build step: `WARNING: layer size mismatch for 3/7`.

Leo P: Confirming canary pods show imagePull and runtime errors: `error: incompatible library version: libnn.so.2.1 required`. Reproduced locally with pulled `latest` image.

Maya R: Impact: only canary traffic (5% route) is failing but routing policy cascading fallback isn't fully engaged; some requests from eu-west-1 experiencing 502s. Customer impact low but increasing. Let's prevent further rollout and rollback canary.

Maya R: Running kill-switch for feature flag `runtime_proxy_canary_enabled` (prod eu-west-1) -> toggling to false.

Sam T: Executing rollback: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/runtime-proxy --to-revision=3`

Sam T: Paste of kubectl output:
```
deployment.apps/runtime-proxy "runtime-proxy" rolled back
status: Rolling back to revision 3
```
CI Bot: Cancelling next pipeline stages for release v1.9.2 to avoid promoting `latest`.

Jia W: I've nuked the `latest` mutable tag in registry and re-tagged stable sha: `registry.redwood/inference/runtime-proxy@sha256:abc123stable`. Set immutable tag policy in repo to disallow `latest` for final images.

Leo P: Routing metrics improving after rollback and flag flip, 502s dropping to baseline.

Maya R: Notifying product & support. Creating incident record: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-1492

Maya R: Quick customer impact note for support: "Small elevated 502s in eu-west-1 for ~20m during canary rollout; most traffic served by stable replicas. No data loss."

Infra Oncall: Handoff in 30m to Sam. Sam, please include remediation steps in oncall notes and open a follow-up to fix CI tagging policy + runbook.

Sam T: Will do. Immediate followups: (1) harden CI to fail on layer size mismatch, (2) enforce immutable digests for production images, (3) add registry webhook alarm when `latest` is mutated, (4) add a canary fallback policy to immediately route to stable if >3% errors in 5m.

Maya R: Postmortem owners: Jia (artifact/repo), Sam (k8s/runbook), Leo (runtime deps). I'll write initial timeline. Target: postmortem draft in 48h.

IncidentBot: Incident severity updated to P3 (mitigated).

Sam T: leaving handoff note: rollback completed at 12:31 UTC, feature flag kill-switch at 12:28 UTC, root cause: CI allowed mutable tag `latest` to be overwritten with a build missing a native lib due to packaging change.

Maya R: Thanks team. If anyone sees lingering 5xx after 12:45 UTC ping here.

Leo P: I pushed a short test suite that verifies native libs present in built image: `scripts/check_native_deps.sh`. I recommend running as part of artifact publish.

Jia W: Created follow-up ticket INFRA-3247 (immutable tags), INFRA-3248 (build validation), INFRA-3249 (registry webhook).

Sam T: handing off to @Infra Oncall for night watch. /cc @support @product

Infra Oncall: taking. I'll monitor dashboards and escalate if errors rise above threshold. Good job all :thumbsup:

Maya R: closing thread for now. Will add timeline + links in incident doc.
